primary_result.condition: m > |F(C)|, where F(C) is the union of monomials appearing in the chosen GF(5) zero-set witnesses; or more generally coefficient-rank < m.
primary_result.scope: All four-input Boolean gates, using degree<=2 witnesses for 215 NPN classes and degree-3 witnesses for the seven remaining classes.

cubic_barrier.nrd_conclusion: Each of the seven homogeneous predicates has NRD Theta(n^3).
cubic_barrier.barrier_scope: This rules out subcubic guarantees for all-ones-except-one redundancy certificates, not arbitrary range-avoidance outputs.

scientific_assessment.assessment: The exact literature mapping removes a false novelty risk and proves a cubic barrier for redundancy-based strategies. The positive result is a structural all-predicate theorem, but not a worst-case improvement for NC0_4-Avoid.

v27_primary: Abandon one-violation redundancy as the primary route for the seven hard predicates. Search for multi-bit forbidden-output certificates, especially low-codimension algebraic relations or cycle automata that bypass Theta(n^3) NRD.
